purpose: Request IBKR option market-data fields for preselected option-chain candidates without touching account, margin, portfolio, or order paths.

candidate_policy.limit_behavior: balance selected quote candidates across symbols before applying max_quote_contracts
candidate_policy.quoted_contract_definition: A contract is counted as quoted only when bid and ask are both positive; close_only confirms field receipt but is not executable liquidity.

warnings.message: HMDS data farm connection is inactive but should be available upon demand.ushmds

known_limitations: The live validation was run before the US options regular session, so bid/ask liquidity was not observed even though close fields were returned.
IBKR may return the active market-data type as live/frozen even when delayed/frozen-delayed was requested, depending on account subscriptions and session state.
This policy does not yet approve liquidity scoring, IV surface construction, spread strategy routing, margin checks, or execution.
